sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-08-v16-quick3/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks row 1; Internal Quality Checks row 1 - no extra annotation beyond the check text)
evidence: instruction.md (3 short paragraphs, sha256 a31f3827...) is a first-person product ask with a motivating use story: line 1 'I'd like a small local playground for working on JavaScript and complete HTML files. The editor itself matters: I often paste a long one-line experiment, format it, make changes in several places, and then run it beside the source. I want to keep the versions that work without losing a draft when another tab saves first.' It contains no numbered acceptance list, no shall/must table, no feature matrix, no framework choice, file layout or endpoint list. The only concrete paths (/app, node /app/server.js, /app/app.db, /instructions, /assets/seed_data.json) are the runtime contract the template requires (quality-checks.md row 4) and are phrased conversationally ('I start it with node /app/server.js'). It ends with a natural hand-over request ('please check it yourself the way I'll use it'). The six notes are all prose paragraphs in the requester's voice, no bullets ('I paste a lot of compact one-line experiments', 'I keep the browser's network panel open while I debug'); behaviour.md:13 now says 'make restores ordinary HTTP requests' with a user reason, not a transport recipe. policy.md:3 explicitly leaves layout, labels, routes, schema and wording to the builder, so there is no build recipe. integration.md:3-9 names port, NODE_PATH-supplied Express/better-sqlite3 and SQLite/DB_PATH; these are environment/runtime facts rather than an implementation recipe and are framed as what the launch image supplies ('You may choose your routes and frontend tools'). ui.md is long and dense (1027 words) and lists many editor behaviours, but each is a user expectation in prose ('When I move up or down through a shorter line, I expect to come back out at the column I started from'), not a checklist; density bears on rows 2/6/7, not on this row. Counterexample probe: a reader cold-reading instruction.md would identify it as a person asking for an app; nothing would mislead a builder into treating it as a spec sheet. No defect found.
